summary:
Coverage audit of spec v4.1 §5 FROZEN (FZ-1 to FZ-13), §6 Context Menu (CM-1 to CM-7) and §12 Undo and Redo (UN-1 to UN-7). It also covers the Appendix A items on freezing, selection and undo: A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A10, A19, A21, A22, A23, A24, A27 and A28. Every source was read only, and no file was written.

There are 183 rows:
- built: 44
- planned for slice 2: 26
- planned for slice 3: 84
- left to slice 4: 8
- left to slice 5: 2
- narrowed by a logged decision: 16
- contradicted: 3
- unassigned: 0

**Built in slice 1.**
- The Context Menu section: fixed height, empty text, summary, labelled Formalize button, icons and the '…' overflow.
- Selecting cards, arrows and ∅ marks: Ctrl adds, the selection rectangle, Select incoming arrows, Esc.
- The right-click menu, apart from fields, vocabulary items and the band.
- The board Undo stack (100 steps per subject, refusing with 'use History') and its lock during a run (UN-3, A27).
- UN-7: hand edits never enter telelean's stacks.

**FROZEN.** None of it is built yet; no core/src/freeze exists. Every FZ clause is committed to by the slice-3 plan, except:
- the transform parts, left to slice 4;
- `#` holding, left to slice 5;
- the logged narrowings: D3-1 (no binding start freezes), D3-4, D3-5, D3-6/7/8/45/46, D3-9 (no 'Allow this change' and no 'meaning changed' items), D3-16/D3-21, D3-27, D3-30 and D3-50.

I read the slice-3 plan at its 21:08 version: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-zhengyew-telelean/20626c17-0334-4498-ad86-9dc24b7010ed/scratchpad/plans/slice3-plan.md, identical to slice3-plan.after_design.md. It is under review, so its section numbers may move.

**Session Undo.** Only core's reducer is built (2a2 and fixer 2a: seal, undo, redo, move, reveal); 2b1a is now amending it. The runner (2e) and the per-view routing (2h) are planned. Three decisions change the spec here:
- D2-54: Submit seals only when it queues Claude steps.
- D2-62: no Undo of decisions while a step runs.
- D3-23: puts back the answer seal that slice 2 leaves out.

**Contradicted.**
1. CM-3 in the built Context Menu: with a mixed selection, actions that fit only part of it stay enabled. Formalize ignores selected cards, and one card's actions stay enabled beside selected arrows or marks. This is unlogged, and slice 2 §5.11 keeps it.
2. CM-3 in slice3-plan §3.6 and §4.3: the freeze actions freeze the freezable part and report the rest as `left`, instead of being shown disabled.
3. CM-7 'everywhere else': the built code deliberately keeps VS Code's default menu on the Vocabulary/Definitions band. Slice 3 adds menus on vocabulary items only.

**Small unlogged departures, noted in the rows.**
- CM-1: on an empty board the section shows the first-step hint instead of the empty text.
- CM-7: the 4 px rule counts any movement, not only press-to-release distance.
- A19: old arrows are not drawn at all.
- FZ-10: the version offers differ by item kind.
- FZ-4: the Result's list of cards whose basis changes does not mark which are frozen.
